echoParts: what to pray for as we ought
but the Spirit himself intercedes for us
with groanings too deep for words.
verseText: Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words.
meaning: The Holy Spirit helps us when we are weak and do not even know how to pray. He intercedes for us and understands needs that are too deep to put into words.
